text:
Maya: Heads up — playbook auto-run kicked for ~120 accounts at 07:04 PT, lots of false positives. Suspect webhook duplicate events + owner=null cases. @liam can you take a look? :eyes:
Liam: on it. any quick query I can run?
Maya: run: SELECT id, owner_id, health_score FROM accounts WHERE last_seen < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND playbook_flag = 'pending';
Devon: looked into logs, saw same event_id repeated 3x from connector-prod between 06:58-07:01. webhook-retry logic spiked. Also 42 accounts have owner = NULL — playbook treats that as 'unowned' and applied reassign nudge.
Sophie: thinking aloud — playbook rule has health_threshold: 0.45 and owner_missing: true. If webhook duplicates retrigger, it will fire repeatedly. here's the current rule snippet:
```
trigger:
  event: account.activity.change
conditions:
  - field: health_score
    op: '<'
    value: 0.45
  - field: owner_id
    op: 'is'
    value: null
actions:
  - type: nudge_owner
    template: onboarding_reengage_v2
rate_limit: 1h
```
Sophie: rate_limit is 1h but duplication bypasses because event_id differs. we should dedupe on external_event_id + account_id.
Liam: quick patch idea: add dedupe key to playbook runner: dedupe_key = concat(account_id, external_event_id) and ignore duplicates within 30m
Devon: can we also add a safeguard: ignore owner_missing if account.last_activity < 90 days? avoids noisy legacy accounts.
Maya: agree. Plan: liam to patch runner for dedupe, devon to run owner backfill for NULLs, sophie to update rule to include last_activity check. I'll open a postmortem doc. cs-bot: Deploy scheduled for 10:30 PT to staging. :shipit:
Liam: patch ready, testing in staging now.
Devon: owner backfill job queued (backfill-owners-2026-03-23). running sample on 50 accounts.
Sophie: updated playbook rule in PR #2846 — added dedupe + last_activity gate.
Maya: thanks — will monitor alerts and pause playbook if we see >50 false triggers/hr. looping in @ops for visibility. :thumbsup:
